# A window inside a window is what every backend already refuses -- html,
# bubbletea and android each panic with "unexpected nested Window" and fyne and
# gtk4 fall into irwalk's generic one. It is reported instead, with the position
# of the inner window, whichever route put it there.

! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --out=out1 direct.sngl
stderr 'direct.sngl:12:9: a window cannot be nested inside another window'

# Inlining is the other route: a component declaring a window, placed in one.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --out=out2 viacomponent.sngl
stderr 'viacomponent.sngl:11:8: a window cannot be nested inside another window'

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out3 direct.sngl
stderr 'a window cannot be nested inside another window'

# A component that declares a window is fine where the window itself would be.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --out=out4 toplevel.sngl
exists out4/model.go

-- direct.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

output {
	go {
		fyne
	}
}

component main ui {
	window(title = "w") {
		window(title = "b") {
			text(value = "x")
		}
	}
}

-- viacomponent.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

output {
	go {
		fyne
	}
}

component inner ui {
	window(title = "b") {
		text(value = "x")
	}
}

component main ui {
	window(title = "w") {
		inner()
	}
}

-- toplevel.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

output {
	go {
		fyne
	}
}

component inner ui {
	window(title = "b") {
		text(value = "x")
	}
}

component main ui {
	inner()
}
